caption: The drawing depicts a single rag doll with a dark, textured face and black hair. The doll is dressed in a brown dress decorated with a repeating pattern of blue and light tan spots. The dress has long sleeves and a gathered waist, and the skirt spreads out widely, giving it a voluminous appearance. The doll’s head is slightly tilted to one side, and its facial features and hair are painted in a way that emphasizes texture and wear. The doll’s feet and hands are black, and the background is plain and unadorned, with an off-white or beige color. There are faint pencil or ink marks near the bottom edge of the drawing, possibly signatures or notes from the artist.
title: Wooden Doll
